messages:
marco.rossi: Hey team — first week here. Trying to get Vault/KMS access for my service (staging -> prod eventually). What’s the process, who approves, and any rotation basics I should follow?

sophia.devex: Welcome Marco! :wave: For Vault access please open an infra request in #platform-requests. Use the template below and tag the service owner. For prod secrets we need an explicit approver from Eng Security. If you need a KMS key, include cloud project + key ring.

rachel.security: Adding: for prod paths I need to be listed as approver or the relevant product manager. Rotation policy: app secrets default to 90 days, short-lived tokens (e.g., CI) rotate monthly or are issued with short TTLs. Customer-managed KMS keys rotate per org policy (we recommend annual rotation).

marco.rossi: Do you have the template I should paste into the ticket?

sophia.devex: Yep — paste this in the ticket body (replace placeholders):

```
secret_request:
  owner: marco.rossi
  service: inference-routing
  env: staging
  path: secret/data/inference-routing/staging
  access: read
  reason: CI needs DB creds for integration tests
  kms: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/redwood/cryptoKeys/inference
  approver: @rachel.security (for prod)
```

rachel.security: A few quick notes: do NOT request broad policies (no wildcard paths). Prefer narrow secret paths per-service. If you need write access, explain why. For ephemeral creds use Vault dynamic secrets (DB/Cloud leases) when possible.

marco.rossi: Got it. For dynamic DB creds — any client libs we prefer?

sophia.devex: We have a small helper lib in infra-shared (go/python) that talks to Vault and caches token via memcache. If you want, I can add you to the repo and show the example.

rachel.security: Also: developers should avoid long-lived static API keys in code. If you must, set rotation cadence and document owner in the ticket (owner is the on-call for that service).

infra-bot: Received ticket #IR-4821 (secret_request). Assigned to infra-ops. ETA 1 business day for staging, 3 for prod.

vault-bot: policy "svc-inference-routing-staging" created and mounted at secret/data/inference-routing/staging (audit id: a1f3).

marco.rossi: Thanks everyone — opening the ticket now with that template and tagging @rachel.security for prod approvals.

sophia.devex: If you run into perms errors after the policy is attached, ping me with the exact curl/wrapped-client error and we’ll debug. :thumbsup:

rachel.security: Welcome aboard — ping here if you need a quick walkthrough of rotation/lease workflows.
